test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the new format, IPL 2022 was played among how many teams in total?
solution:
The correct answer is** __10__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Indian Premier League**

 
 
• As per the new format,** IPL 2022** was played among** 10 teams** in total.
 
• The** 2022 Indian Premier League**, often referred to as** IPL 15** or, for sponsorship purposes,** Tata IPL 2022**, was the league's fifteenth season **(IPL). **
 
• The competition took place between** 26 March 2022** and **29 May 2022**. Mumbai and Pune, both in the state of **Maharashtra**, hosted the **games** during the competition's group stage.
 
• The entire tournament **schedule **was published on** March 6, 2022**. **Yeh Ab Normal Hai was the slogan**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Additionally, the** BCCI** declared that two of the six towns it shortlisted—**Ahmedabad**, **Cuttack**, **Dharamshala**, **Guwahati**, **Indore**, and **Lucknow**—would serve as the locations for the **franchises**.
 
• On **January 11, 2022**, Vivo resigned as the tournament's title sponsor. **Vivo **secured a contract to serve as the title sponsor through **2023 **after withdrawing as a sponsor in **2020**.
 
• For the remaining year of Vivo's deal, The** Tata Group **was designated as the title **sponsor**.
